scope: Exploratory diagnosis on the same previously seen 16 coordinates and two protocols; no new fit, optimization, exclusions, noise inference, grading threshold or biological claim

selection.rule: reuse exact prior selection, never rerank by residual

source_reconstruction.datatype: NIfTI-1 single-file uint16, endian parsed, x index fastest
source_reconstruction.scaling: apply finite nonzero slope/intercept; zero or nonfinite slope means identity; reject active nonfinite intercept
source_reconstruction.volume_indices: 0 through 128; check exact original bval/bvec ordering against cache, no flip or normalization
source_reconstruction.intermediate_dtype: float64 after NIfTI intensity scaling; Gaussian weights, products and accumulated sums are float64; no uint16/float32 filtering intermediates
source_reconstruction.axis_handling: i,j,k voxel axes; source uses sequential 1D filtering across axes 0,1,2 with float64 intermediates; diagnostic uses equivalent 3D product weights with a different float64 summation order
source_reconstruction.method: stream one original volume at a time; independently evaluate direct separable-product Gaussian weights on 27 neighbors at each selected coordinate

arithmetic_checks.meaning: implementation compatibility only, not scientific error bars or scoring thresholds

diagnostics.candidate_scope: every retained parameter candidate among all768 attempts; cap-aborted attempts remain unresolved without invented candidates
diagnostics.forward_implementation: new independent scalar quadratic-form evaluation; no pilot/witness forward imports
diagnostics.domain: recompute the exact already frozen phase1 domain and roundoff semantics without modification
diagnostics.directional_output: every direction for each of32 preexisting best-feasible voxel/protocol slots; choosing diagnostic representatives does not alter the16-voxel analysis support
summaries: observed diffusion signal above observed b0 and fitted S0
diagnostics.qc_interpretation: descriptive counts; neither a noise model nor exclusion thresholds

release_boundary: Completion narrows possible implementation/source explanations; it does not establish biological adequacy, calibrated identifiability, task difficulty or release readiness
